questions.question: How many depository libraries did GPO staff visit in FY 2018?
questions.expected_answer: GPO staff visited 166 depository libraries in 25 states in FY 2018.
questions.notes: Stated in the Director’s message (p.5) and under the FDLP (p.21). The 3-year total (over 610) is extra information the mentor bar rules out.

questions.question: What new digital system replaced FDsys, and when was it fully deployed?
questions.expected_answer: govinfo (www.govinfo.gov) replaced FDsys. Its full-scale deployment took place over FY 2018: it came out of beta in December 2017, ran in parallel with FDsys through 2018, and FDsys was scheduled to be completely retired and replaced by govinfo in December 2018.
questions.notes: p.4: full-scale deployment of govinfo during FY 2018; p.22: out of beta Dec 2017, FDsys to be fully replaced Dec 2018. Either date framing is acceptable if it is what the cited page says.

questions.question: How much did GPO procure in printing and information products in FY 2018 on behalf of federal agencies?
questions.expected_answer: More than $375 million worth of printing and other information products (about 84,000 orders); the By the Numbers page gives $375.7 million.
questions.notes: $341.5 million is the cost of procured work (an expense) and $874 million is total revenue — both are wrong answers.
